intakeRules: Use the iCloud SEIS repository as the canonical destination.
Never bulk copy dirty source repositories over canonical files.
Large zip archives stay in the iCloud archive layer, not in Git history.
Portfolio code enters only through a dedicated portfolio intake mission.
AI tooling repositories remain references unless a mission explicitly needs a small artifact.
Every imported file must map to a mission, domain, owner agent, validation command, and rollback path.
